name: Maya
label: Waits for gradual feature rollouts
who: I'm on Premium Duo with my wife and I listen on my phone, with Discover Weekly as a regular part of my week. I pay attention to new features and check the app when they are rolled out gradually.
value_for_money: Mixed. One user says a feature was well worth the wait, while another says a price increase brought back messages and felt like their money was going to pointless features. One user cancelled after a feature they were waiting for did not arrive.
loyalty: Stays for features that eventually arrive and for Discover Weekly. Would leave if promised features never reach their account, and one user cancelled for that reason while saying they might come back later.
pain_points: Features roll out slowly and unpredictably
Discover Weekly sometimes does not refresh
Hard to tell whether an app update is the cause
Promised updates do not reach some accounts
likes: The new Your updates feature once it arrived
reasons_to_stay: They value Discover Weekly and new features, and they wait for those features to arrive on their account. Once a feature finally shows up on Duo, they say it is worth the wait, so they keep the subscription for what comes next.
tone: Upbeat and casual, with short posts, shrugs and emojis.
